> @copilot fix all

All 4 review comments addressed in d4eca39:

1. **`chatWithTools` abort vs max-iterations**: `abortedByCallback` tracked outside the loop; distinct log messages for abort (`[AI] chatWithTools aborted by onToolError callback`) vs exhaustion (`[AI] chatWithTools max iterations reached`).
2. **`streamChatWithTools` double model call**: Final round now emits the already-probed result as `text-delta` + `finish` instead of calling `streamChat`/`chat` a second time.
3. **`POST /conversations` body validation**: Added type check — returns 400 for non-object payloads (string, number, array) before any mutation.
4. **CHANGELOG.md**: Updated to reflect backward-compatible ownership behavior (only enforced when user context is present and conversation has a `userId`).
